verdict.rationale: Semgrep's core CLI/engine is open source and runs entirely on local infrastructure by default, never uploading code, and works without an account or login, which is effectively self-hosting the core scanning product (semgrep-gh-2, semgrep-docs-33/34/50/51/27). Missing for 10: explicit documentation of self-hosting the full AppSec Platform/server components, and independent hands-on confirmation of a self-hosted enterprise deployment.
